products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute is a government research lab founded in 2020 and part of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. The institute describes itself as "a leading global scientific research center" and characterizes its mission as "Making Advanced AI accessible and Available to Everyone, Everywhere."

The institute develops the Falcon family of open-source large language models. Its flagship model, Falcon 180B, has 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens and ranks at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models. The Falcon series also includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E models designed for efficiency and scalability, Falcon 2 11B described as multilingual and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities, Falcon Arabic for Arabic-language applications, Falcon Mamba 7B as an open-source State Space Language Model, and Falcon Perception as a multimodal model for image understanding. All models are available under Apache 2.0 licensing for research and commercial use. In 2024, the Technology Innovation Institute launched the non-profit Falcon Foundation to advance open-source generative AI development and build sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.
